# R8 verification

The sample app enables code shrinking, optimization, obfuscation and resource
shrinking in both `debug` and `release`. Development therefore exercises the
libraries' packaged consumer rules instead of postponing R8 until publication.
The `debug` variant is deliberately non-debuggable: AGP otherwise disables code
optimization and obfuscation even when minification is enabled. Use logcat and
the matching R8 mapping for diagnosis; breakpoint debugging is unavailable.
Only the signed **release** APK is uploaded to GitHub Releases, together with
its `HaishinKit-<version>-mapping.txt` for R8 retrace.

AGP 9.2 uses R8 full mode by default. `gradle.properties` also enables strict
full-mode keep rules, optimized resource shrinking and app compile-time R
classes, and uses AGP 9's reduced dependency-constraint default. Non-transitive
and non-final R classes retain their AGP defaults. Kotlin/DSL compatibility
switches remain separate from runtime optimization.

Keep JNI/reflection rules in the owning library's `consumer-rules.pro`, so an
app consuming its AAR receives the same protections. Shader requirement
annotations and uniform getter names are reflected by OpenGL/Vulkan, so their
consumer rules must be tested with actual rendered frames. Do not solve failures by
keeping all HaishinKit classes or disabling R8. The sample's debug-only rules
cover optional providers of its local MCP server; they do not apply to the
distributed release APK.

```sh
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleRelease :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:testUiTestUnitTest
./gradlew :app:connectedUiTestAndroidTest
```

The shared Fastlane review lane builds both optimized APK variants. Native
compilation remains enabled in CI. Release signing uses the existing APK secrets.
Without signing credentials, the release build produces an unsigned APK.

For each build, retain `app/build/outputs/mapping/<variant>/mapping.txt` alongside
the exact APK when investigating a crash. Use R8 retrace with that mapping;
a mapping from another commit or variant is not interchangeable. Exercise real
camera composition and the RTMP, SRT and RTC paths before a library release.

The white-box Compose tests use a dedicated unminified `uiTest` variant because
they directly call app internals that R8 may remove. Also smoke-test the actual
optimized debug/release APK with external device UI controls.

Unit tests alone do not execute native callbacks or reflected entry points.

References: [R8 setup](https://developer.android.com/topic/performance/app-optimization/enable-app-optimization)
and [AGP 9 changes](https://developer.android.com/build/releases/agp-9-0-0-release-notes).
